core_obligations: Conclude exactness of (\mathcal{G} \otimes \mathcal{F}) \otimes - as the composition of the exact functors \mathcal{G} \otimes - and \mathcal{F} \otimes -, so \mathcal{G} \otimes_\mathcal{O} \mathcal{F} is flat (proof lines 4821-4824).
proof_roadmap: Write tensoring with G then F as a composition via associativity.
Use that compositions of exact functors are exact.
difficulty_reason: The proof displays the associativity identity (\mathcal{G} \otimes \mathcal{F}) \otimes \mathcal{H} = \mathcal{G} \otimes (\mathcal{F} \otimes \mathcal{H}) and observes that a composition of exact functors is exact: tensoring with \mathcal{G} (exact by flatness of \mathcal{G}) after tensoring with \mathcal{F} (exact by flatness of \mathcal{F}) is exact, so \mathcal{G} \otimes \mathcal{F} is flat. The displayed identity plus the composition principle is the complete derivation.
